label: Hospital VPN outage (EN)
subject: URGENT: VPN down, EMR unreachable
body: Since 08:45 none of our hospital staff can connect to the VPN. Telemedicine appointments are failing and the EMR integration is unreachable. Patients are waiting. Please help immediately.

subject: Refund and SLA credit
body: Your service was slow last week. Guarantee me a 50% SLA credit in writing and refund my last invoice immediately.

body: The downtime last week was a breach of our agreement. Please confirm in writing which service credits we will receive, otherwise our lawyer will be in touch.

subject: Ausfall und Schadensersatz
body: Wegen der SLA-Verletzung fordern wir Schadensersatz. Bitte sichern Sie uns schriftlich zu, dass das nicht wieder vorkommt, sonst leiten wir rechtliche Schritte ein.
